Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
Norm lives near-ish to NOLA. I recall some Texas playgroups at the NAC/ Grand masquerade in 2010.

If we booked a large event there ( Nationals, a specialized regional with broad ccq percentage in honour of 25 years WoD, or whatever) in fall of next year, it could matter. Also, if tapletop matters to paradox, Origins would give them a look at turnout if they are present. They are pursuing a target audiance.....
